minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 火元素的純粹爆發，代表全新的行動力。在遊戲中賦予強大的初始爆發力或開局額外行動點數。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: An ethereal glowing hand emerging from a subtle cloud, holding a sturdy wooden wand radiating golden magical fire. Glowing green leaves falling. A distant fantasy castle. Dynamic and energetic.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 站在高處俯瞰全局，代表戰略規劃。在遊戲中可預覽敵方下一步行動，或擴大攻擊視野。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A noble lord standing on a high castle wall, looking out over a vast ocean. Holding a glowing crystal globe in one hand. Two magical wands planted nearby. Strategic and visionary atmosphere.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 等待出航的船隻，象徵力量的擴張。在遊戲中代表持續性的增益效果(Buff)，或召喚遠程火力支援。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A traveler facing away, looking at mystical glowing ships on a golden sea. Three flaming wands planted in the ground. Warm sunset lighting, sense of grand expansion.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 穩固的基礎與勝利的慶祝。在遊戲中提供一個絕對安全的庇護所(無敵回合)，或恢復全隊士氣。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A celebratory scene with four magical wands forming a stable pavilion adorned with glowing floral garlands. Joyful ethereal figures dancing in the background near a safe castle. Festive and secure.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 混亂與競爭的能量。在遊戲中引發無差別的混亂攻擊(隨機目標)，或增加敵我雙方的暴擊率。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: Five energetic youths in dynamic poses swinging glowing wooden wands in a chaotic but non-lethal mock battle. Sparks flying, dust kicking up. Intense kinetic energy.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 凱旋而歸的英雄。在遊戲中賦予強大的「光環」效果，提升周圍友軍的所有屬性。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A victorious knight riding a noble white horse. Wearing a glowing laurel wreath. Holding a flaming wand high. Cheering ethereal crowd in the background. Glorious golden lighting.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 面對群敵依然堅守陣地。在遊戲中獲得「反擊」狀態，受到攻擊時自動使用火元素反擊。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A fierce warrior standing on a rugged elevated cliff, defensively holding one glowing wand to block six other magical wands thrusting up from below. Intense defensive action.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 無可阻擋的極速飛馳。在遊戲中象徵「神速」，使玩家獲得額外回合，或發動無法閃避的連擊。
visual_symbols: 八根在空中飛行的權杖
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: Eight magical flaming wands flying swiftly in formation through a clear blue sky over an open landscape. Like arcane meteors. Speed and rapid forward momentum.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 經歷戰鬥後的傷痕與警惕。在遊戲中代表「背水一戰」，血量越低，防禦與攻擊力越高。
visual_symbols: 身後八根權杖組成的柵欄
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A battle-weary but resilient warrior with a glowing bandage on his head, leaning on a fiery wand. Behind him, a defensive palisade made of eight upright wands. Tension and endurance.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 承受極大的壓力與過載的能量。在遊戲中可犧牲自身速度與迴避率，換取一次毀滅性的重擊。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A burdened figure struggling to carry ten glowing, heavy magical wands, bent over from the weight. Walking towards a distant village. Heavy shadows and oppressive atmosphere.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 火元素的火種，充滿好奇心。在遊戲中為玩家帶來增益Buff的隨機觸發，或揭示隱藏的地圖情報。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A curious young page holding a magical wand, gazing in wonder at the glowing leaves sprouting from it. Standing in a mystic desert. Wearing clothes adorned with subtle salamander patterns.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 火元素的狂飆，不顧一切的衝鋒。在遊戲中象徵「突進」技能，對直線上的敵人造成火焰穿透傷害。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A fierce knight in glowing armor charging forward on a rearing horse. A flaming red cloak trailing behind him. Holding a blazing wand. Dynamic action, fire sparks everywhere.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 火元素的溫暖與光芒，極具感染力。在遊戲中能施放強大的持續性增益(光環)，並有機率魅惑敵人。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A confident, charismatic queen sitting on a throne decorated with lions. Holding a glowing wand and a bright sunflower. A mystical black cat at her feet. Warm, radiant arcane aura.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 火元素的絕對掌控，領袖的威嚴。在遊戲中能召喚強大的火元素使魔，或對全場敵人施加毀滅性灼燒。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A commanding king sitting on a fiery throne. Wearing a glowing crown of flames and robes with salamander motifs. Holding a massive glowing wand. Authoritative magical fire energy.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 水元素的源泉，代表純粹的治癒與情感。在遊戲中提供一次全隊狀態的完全恢復，並淨化所有負面Debuff。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A divine glowing cup held by an ethereal hand from the clouds. Five streams of glowing water overflowing into a mystical pond filled with blooming lotuses. A white dove descending. Pure healing energy.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 平等的交流與連結。在遊戲中觸發「生命連結」機制，與一名隊友共享生命值與增益，分擔傷害。
visual_symbols: 雙翼獅子頭(赫密士之杖)
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A man and woman standing face to face, gently touching their glowing golden cups together. Above them, a mystical caduceus with a winged lion head. Harmonious, romantic, magical bond.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 團隊的和諧共鳴。在遊戲中發動強大的組合技(Combo)加成，隊伍人數越多，回血與Buff效果越強。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: Three joyful women in elegant flowing dresses dancing and raising their glowing golden cups together in a toast. Surrounded by mystical glowing fruits and flowers. Joyful magical celebration.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 對現狀的不滿與沉思。在遊戲中代表「冥想」狀態，玩家放棄一回合行動以大幅度回復魔力(Mana)。
visual_symbols: 雲中遞來的第四個聖杯
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A contemplative figure sitting cross-armed under a mystical tree. Three golden cups on the ground before him. An ethereal hand emerging from a cloud offering a fourth glowing cup. Moody, introspective atmosphere.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 損失與悲痛，但仍有殘存的希望。在遊戲中，獻祭部分生命值以換取強大的護盾，或從墓地回收一張卡牌。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A sorrowful figure in a dark heavy cloak looking down at three spilled glowing cups. Behind the figure, two golden cups remain standing upright. A stone bridge and gloomy sky in the background.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 純真與過去的饋贈。在遊戲中能「重置」技能冷卻時間，或使角色狀態回溯到前幾個回合的健康狀態。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: Two innocent children in an old magical courtyard. One child handing the other a golden cup filled with glowing white flowers. Five other floral cups around them. Warm, nostalgic golden light.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 迷幻與過多的選擇。在遊戲中施放「幻影」，製造分身干擾敵人攻擊，或從隨機的魔法寶物中抽取一項增益。
visual_symbols: 杯中充滿不同的幻象(財寶、龍、蛇、城堡等)
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A shadowed figure gazing in awe at seven glowing cups floating on mystic clouds. Each cup contains a different magical illusion: jewels, a dragon, a snake, a glowing castle. Dreamlike and mysterious.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 捨棄現有的成就去追尋更高的真理。在遊戲中能「強制脫戰」或清除場上所有增益/減益狀態，回歸平靜。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A traveler in a red cloak walking away with a staff towards rugged mystical mountains. Leaving behind eight perfectly stacked golden cups. A glowing crescent moon in the night sky. Melancholic journey.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 被稱為「願望牌」，代表情感與物質的滿足。在遊戲中可直接觸發一次暴擊補血，或獲得大量的魔力/資源。
visual_symbols: 身後半圓形排列的九個聖杯
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A very satisfied, confident figure sitting on a comfortable wooden bench, arms crossed. Behind him, nine glowing golden cups are arranged perfectly in an arc on a curved table. Aura of success and magical fulfillment.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 情感的終極圓滿與神聖的庇護。在遊戲中提供強大的全體持續恢復(Regen)，並使隊伍免疫任何心智控制。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A joyful family raising their arms to the sky. A brilliant mystical rainbow arches overhead, holding ten glowing golden cups. A beautiful peaceful river and cottage in the background. Ultimate emotional bliss.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 情感與直覺的萌芽。在遊戲中提供微量的自動回血，或看破敵方的隱藏弱點(直覺洞察)。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A gentle young page looking playfully into a golden cup he is holding. A glowing mystical fish is popping its head out of the cup. Soft ocean waves in the background. Whimsical and intuitive.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 優雅的使者，帶著治癒的能量。在遊戲中能施放「淨化之泉」，解除隊友的負面狀態並賦予水元素護盾。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A graceful knight in elegant armor riding a calm white horse. Wearing a helmet and boots with small mystical wings. Holding a glowing cup as if making an offering. Crossing a gentle glowing river.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 情感的守護者，深不可測的潛意識。在遊戲中是頂級的輔助者，能施放大範圍的群體治癒，並反彈敵方的精神攻擊。
visual_symbols: 手持裝飾華麗的封閉聖杯
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A beautiful, ethereal queen sitting on a throne at the edge of the mystical sea. Holding a highly ornate, closed glowing chalice. Water elemental motifs around her. Deep calm and profound intuitive magic.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 風暴中的寧靜，情緒的絕對掌控者。在遊戲中能創造「深海領域」，使全場敵人減速，並巨幅提升友軍的水系魔法威力。
visual_symbols: 一手拿聖杯一手拿權杖
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A serene, mature king sitting on a throne that floats firmly on turbulent mystical waters. Holding a glowing golden cup and a scepter. A ship and a magical dolphin in the stormy background. Absolute emotional mastery.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 風元素的極致鋒利，斬斷一切迷惘的真理之劍。在遊戲中代表絕對的「破甲」或真實傷害，無視敵方護盾。
visual_symbols: 皇冠垂下的橄欖與棕櫚
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: An ethereal hand from a cloud firmly gripping a glowing, razor-sharp double-edged sword. A golden crown rests on the tip of the sword, draped with glowing olive and palm branches. Cold, jagged mystical mountains.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 蒙眼防禦，維持脆弱的平衡。在遊戲中賦予「格擋」狀態，抵消一次致命攻擊，但自身無法移動。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A blindfolded woman sitting on a stone block, holding two heavy glowing swords crossed perfectly over her chest. A crescent moon in the dark sky. Still water and rocks behind her. Tense magical standoff.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 穿透心靈的痛楚與傷害。在遊戲中能對敵人施加「流血」與「虛弱」Debuff，造成持續性的暗傷。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: Three cold glowing swords piercing directly through a mystical glowing red heart floating in the sky. Heavy dark clouds, pouring rain, and arcane lightning. Intense emotional sorrow and piercing damage.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 戰鬥後的休養生息。在遊戲中使目標進入「沉睡」狀態，期間無法行動但會快速恢復生命力。
visual_symbols: 牆上三把劍，床下一把劍
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A knight resting peacefully, hands in prayer, on a stone tomb inside a glowing majestic cathedral. Three ethereal swords hang on the wall, one lies beside him. Stained glass window letting in soft colored light.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 不擇手段的險勝。在遊戲中能「偷取」敵方的增益Buff，或是以犧牲隊友血量為代價發動強力攻擊。
visual_symbols: 背後兩個失敗者黯然離開
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A smug warrior holding three glowing swords, watching two defeated figures walk away in shame. Two other swords lie discarded on the ground. Jagged storm clouds and harsh wind. Treacherous magical victory.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 從波濤洶湧駛向平靜的水域。在遊戲中代表「轉移」，能將自身的Debuff轉移給敵人，或是進行戰術撤退。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A boatman punting a small wooden boat across mystical waters. In the boat, a hooded figure sits quietly. Six glowing swords stand upright in the boat's bow. Water transitions from turbulent to calm.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 巧妙的潛行與戰術。在遊戲中賦予「隱身」或「閃避」極大提升，並能無視護甲進行背刺暗殺。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A sneaky rogue tip-toeing away from a mystical military camp, carrying five glowing swords in his arms. Looking back over his shoulder. Two swords are left planted in the ground behind him. Stealth and cunning.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 被自我恐懼與外力束縛。在遊戲中對敵人施加「禁錮」或「沉默」狀態，使其無法使用技能。
visual_symbols: 周圍插著八把劍形成牢籠
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A woman blindfolded and loosely bound, standing in a shallow pool of water. Surrounded by eight glowing swords thrust into the ground, forming a cage. A distant gloomy castle. Feeling of magical restriction.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 極度的精神折磨與恐懼。在遊戲中引發「恐懼」狀態，大幅降低敵方的命中率與士氣，並造成強烈的精神傷害。
visual_symbols: 被子上有星座/戰鬥圖案
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A person sitting up in bed, covering their face in despair and weeping. Nine glowing magical swords hang horizontally on the dark wall behind them. The blanket has arcane astrological patterns. Intense nightmare atmosphere.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 慘烈的終結與無法挽回的毀滅。在遊戲中象徵「斬殺」機制，對低血量敵人造成直接致死傷害(秒殺)。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A figure lying face down on the ground, completely defeated, with ten glowing swords piercing their back. Dark, oppressive sky overhead, but a golden mystical sunrise is just beginning to break on the distant horizon.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 敏銳的觀察力與靈活的思維。在遊戲中能「洞察」敵方的行動意圖，或增加全隊的閃避率與暴擊率。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A vigilant young page holding a glowing sword, standing on a rugged terrain. Wind whipping through his hair and the trees behind him. Fast-moving clouds in the sky. Sharp, alert magical energy.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 風馳電掣的狂飆突進。在遊戲中象徵「先攻」，具備最高速度，能發動快速且無視防禦的連續突刺。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: An aggressive knight in full armor charging fiercely on a galloping white horse. Raising a glowing sword high. A red cloak whipping wildly in the strong wind. Stormy, kinetic magical speed.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 斬斷情感的絕對理智。在遊戲中能發動「真實之眼」，驅散所有幻象與偽裝，並精準攻擊敵方的致命弱點。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A stern, highly intelligent queen sitting on an elevated throne made of stone. Holding a glowing sword straight up with one hand, the other hand extended. Butterfly motifs. Clear sky, sharp and absolute intellect.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 智力與法則的最高掌控者。在遊戲中能施放「領域展開」，制定戰場規則（如：禁止使用回復魔法），或對全體造成強大的風刃AOE傷害。
visual_symbols: 背後有樹木與兩隻飛鳥
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: An authoritative, calm king sitting on a throne adorned with butterflies and crescent moons. Holding a large glowing sword at a slight angle. Two birds flying in a clear, windy sky behind him. Master of magical laws.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 土元素的根基，代表物質與財富的降臨。在遊戲中賦予強大的「物理護盾」，或在一場戰鬥後獲得雙倍的資源掉落。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: An ethereal hand from a cloud holding a massive, glowing golden pentacle coin. Below is a lush, highly detailed mystical garden with blooming white lilies and an overgrown archway. Solid, abundant magic.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 在變動中維持資源的平衡。在遊戲中可「轉換」屬性，將攻擊力轉化為防禦力，或是將生命值與魔力值互換。
visual_symbols: 手中的兩個星幣與無限符號
背景起伏的海浪與船隻
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A vibrant youth dynamically juggling two glowing golden pentacle coins, enclosed by an ethereal glowing green infinity symbol. In the background, magical ships ride up and down on large ocean waves. Adaptable energy.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 透過專業合作打造堅不可摧的防禦。在遊戲中能「構築」防禦工事，提升全隊的護甲值，或修復已損壞的裝備。
visual_symbols: 教堂拱門上的三個星幣
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A master stonemason carving an intricate stone arch in a mystic cathedral. An architect and a monk stand beside him holding plans. Three glowing golden pentacles are embedded in the stone archway. Teamwork and magical craftsmanship.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 極度保守與防禦。在遊戲中進入「絕對防禦」姿態，減免大量傷害，但代價是該回合無法進行任何攻擊。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A miserly figure sitting tightly, balancing a glowing golden pentacle on his head, hugging one tightly to his chest, and pinning two more under his feet. A distant city behind him. Aura of rigid magical protection and hoarding.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 物質的匱乏與艱難的環境。在遊戲中這是一張「環境卡」，使戰場進入暴風雪狀態，全場每回合扣除生命值並降低防禦。
visual_symbols: 教堂彩繪玻璃上的五個星幣
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: Two impoverished, injured figures walking through heavy, bitter snow. Behind them is a warm, glowing stained-glass window of a mystic church, featuring five golden pentacles. Contrast between harsh environment and missed magical salvation.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 資源的分配與平衡。在遊戲中能「均攤」隊伍血量(將所有隊友血量加總後平分)，或是將多餘的魔力轉給隊友。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A wealthy, noble figure holding perfectly balanced magical scales in one hand, while dropping glowing golden coins into the hands of two grateful beggars with the other. Six pentacles float above. Ethereal aura of charity and balance.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 漫長的成長與收成。在遊戲中施放「成長」Buff，每經過一個回合，該角色的攻擊力與防禦力就會隨之疊加提升。
visual_symbols: 看著藤蔓上長出的七個星幣
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A tired but patient farmer leaning on a wooden hoe, looking at a lush magical green vine where seven glowing golden pentacles are growing like fruit. Peaceful, rewarding agrarian magic.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 專注於技藝的磨練。在遊戲中能「強化」裝備，短暫提升武器的暴擊倍率或護甲的耐久度。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A dedicated magical artisan sitting on a bench, meticulously carving a glowing golden pentacle with a hammer and chisel. Finished pentacles are displayed on a wooden post. Highly focused, detailed magical craftsmanship.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 物質的極致享受與自給自足。在遊戲中賦予強大的「單體免疫」護盾，並每回合自動獲得一定數量的金幣或資源。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: An elegant, richly dressed woman standing alone in a lush, magical vineyard full of glowing grapes. A hooded falcon rests calmly on her gloved hand. Nine glowing pentacles surround her. Aura of luxurious independence and earthly magic.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 土元素的終極圓滿，堅若磐石的傳承。在遊戲中能召喚「先祖守衛」，提供全場最高等級的防禦增益與物理傷害減免。
visual_symbols: 拱門上的生命之樹圖案(十個星幣)
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A rich, detailed scene of an old wise man petting two dogs, while a happy couple and child stand nearby. In the foreground, an elaborate archway carved with the Kabbalistic Tree of Life made of ten glowing golden pentacles. Ultimate legacy.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 踏實穩健的學習者。在遊戲中能「搜尋」戰場，高機率挖出隱藏的道具、補血藥劑或稀有素材。
visual_symbols: 捧著一個星幣仔細端詳
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A studious young page standing in a blooming magical meadow, carefully holding and studying a glowing golden pentacle. Lush forests and a stable mountain in the background. Earthy, grounded mystical energy.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 最堅固的重裝坦克。在遊戲中擁有極高的嘲諷值與護甲，能強制吸引敵方火力，保護脆弱的隊友。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A heavy-set knight in thick glowing armor sitting on a sturdy, stationary black horse. Holding a glowing golden pentacle carefully. Looking out over freshly plowed mystical fields. Immovable, highly defensive presence.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 大地的滋養者。在遊戲中不僅提供強大的土系防禦，還能給予全隊「吸血」效果，在造成物理傷害時恢復生命值。
visual_symbols: 坐在裝飾繁複的寶座上
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A motherly, pragmatic queen sitting on a stone throne carved with fruits and animals. Holding a glowing golden pentacle in her lap. A magical rabbit jumps at her feet. Surrounded by incredibly rich, overgrown nature. Grounded magic.

minor_arcana_cards.core_meaning: 物質世界的絕對霸主。在遊戲中能施放「點石成金」，有機率直接將低階敵人秒殺並轉化為大量金幣，或為全隊施加最頂級的荊棘反傷護甲。
minor_arcana_cards.ai_prompt_hint: A wealthy, imposing king sitting on a dark stone throne adorned with bull heads. Heavy vines with glowing mystical grapes wrap around the throne. A majestic castle in the background. Resting his foot on a giant glowing golden pentacle. Master of material magic.
